svg.title: Rebuild Lambda indexes and signs repo metadata
svg.desc: Publisher Puts rpm/deb under repos/. EventBridge invokes the rebuild Lambda, which pulls the lab GPG private key from Secrets Manager, runs createrepo_c and apt-ftparchive, signs metadata, writes indexes back to the package bucket, and refreshes catalog.json plus the public key on the UI bucket.
svg.text: Private key stays in Secrets Manager; Lambda imports into ephemeral GNUPGHOME under /tmp per invoke
